predecessors.Q17A: exactly identical passive causal structures; interventions make DAG direction distinguishable (information-sufficiency PASS)
predecessors.Q17B: learned two-edge factorization DEV NO-GO; stronger flat comparator, oracle gap; no holdout
predecessors.Q17C: 1-ULP platform tanh difference at frozen initial RNN hidden update; entire training divergence not proven

hypothesis: A single shared learned edge-evidence calibration, composed by topology-aware path enumeration without hardwired edge identities, can predict path existence after structural rewiring better than fully trained flat path-feature, graph-sequence recurrent and symbolic threshold controls, at equal public interventions and bounded memory.

data.world: Directed acyclic graph, public ordered node IDs, public candidate edge skeleton and query from first to last node; each candidate edge independently either causally present or absent (equal prior); only compositional query ground truth (reachable from source to sink) is supervised.
data.evidence: Each publicly listed potential edge receives exactly 12 randomized do(source) probes; observed terminal match count k is binomial(12, 0.8) if causal edge exists, binomial(12,0.5) if absent. All models receive edge endpoints, public skeleton, number of probes and all match counts. The generation of k is blinded to learners and to inference; no edge-presence labels.
data.train_labels: only full path reachability yes/no, never individual latent edge presence

candidate.name: SHARED_EDGE_CAUSAL_COMPOSITOR
candidate.form: q_uv=sigmoid(a*(k_uv/12-0.5)+b); P(path)=sum over all 2^E latent edge presence patterns [I(reachable)*prod_edge Bernoulli(q_uv)]

flat.name: TRAINED_TOPOLOGY_PATH_FEATURES
flat.form: sigmoid(linear weights on [1, mean evidence, minimum edge evidence, maximum path-min evidence, largest path-product evidence, edge count/4, path count/2])

recurrent.name: TRAINED_TWO_STATE_GRAPH_RNN
recurrent.form: two tanh states sequentially read edge evidence and node-span; output sigmoid(v0*h0+v1*h1+b) with 11 trainable params

symbolic.name: TRAINED_SYMBOLIC_REACHABILITY
symbolic.form: fit one integer threshold 0..12 on FIT composed labels, infer edge presence if matches >=threshold, exact Boolean reachability; FIT-only Laplace calibrated positive/negative output probabilities

bayes.name: KNOWN_LAW_ORACLE_BAYES
bayes.form: exact posterior edge presence from specified true 0.8/0.5 emission probabilities and 0.5 prior followed by exact path enumeration

fit.optimizer: finite difference Adam on Bernoulli cross-entropy using FIT composed labels only, 2 preregistered restarts and fixed minibatch shuffles
fit.select_checkpoint: one selection at last epoch using 128 DEV loss across two restarts, no gradient on DEV
fit.accounting: Measure complete training CPU process time, inference CPU process time, Python memory tracemalloc peak, checkpoint bytes and actual online state scalar usage; Linux and Windows numeric differences must be reported, not silently treated as identical
